title: Battery Fast Drain
canonical_query: battery drains quickly during normal use
paraphrases: Why is my Galaxy draining overnight
Phone battery is running down fast
reference_text: Open Settings. Tap Battery. Open Battery usage details and review apps using the most battery. Return to Battery and open Power saving. Choose a suitable power saving mode. Restart the phone after saving changes.

actions.description: It will identify heavy battery consumers
steps: Review apps using the most battery.

actions.description: It will reduce background battery consumption
steps: Choose a suitable power saving mode.

actions.description: It will apply saved battery changes
steps: Restart the phone after saving changes.

title: Screen Flicker
canonical_query: display flickers during scrolling or low brightness
reference_text: Open Display settings. Tap Adaptive brightness and turn it off temporarily. Set brightness to the middle level. Open Motion smoothness. Choose Standard and observe the display. Restart the phone if flickering continues.

actions.description: It will isolate automatic brightness changes
steps: Set brightness to the middle level.

actions.description: It will test refresh rate stability
It will reload the display system
steps: Restart the phone if flickering continues.

title: Camera Image Blur
canonical_query: camera photos remain blurry in normal lighting
reference_text: Open Camera settings. Turn Scene optimizer off and on. Reset Camera settings if focus remains unstable. Wipe the camera lens with a clean dry microfiber cloth. Remove any lens protector that covers the camera.

actions.description: It will refresh camera processing options
steps: Reset Camera settings if focus remains unstable.

actions.description: It will remove physical focus obstruction
steps: Wipe the camera lens with a clean dry microfiber cloth.
Remove any lens protector that covers the camera.

title: Slow After Update
canonical_query: device performance slow after software update
paraphrases: My phone became slow after updating
Apps lag since the software update
The new update made everything sluggish
Phone takes longer to open apps
Device is slow since yesterday's update
reference_text: Open Device care. Tap Optimize now and wait for completion. Open Memory. Review memory use and tap Clean now. Restart the device after optimization completes.

actions.description: It will resolve common performance bottlenecks
It will release unused application memory
It will reload optimized system services
steps: Restart the device after optimization completes.

title: Wi Fi Disconnections
paraphrases: Phone loses Wi-Fi every few minutes
reference_text: Open Wi-Fi settings. Select the connected network and tap Forget. Connect to the network again. Open Intelligent Wi-Fi settings. Turn Switch to mobile data off while testing. Restart the router manually if other devices also disconnect.

actions.description: It will refresh saved network credentials
It will prevent automatic network switching
steps: Turn Switch to mobile data off while testing.

actions.description: It will refresh the wireless connection
steps: Restart the router manually if other devices also disconnect.

title: Bluetooth Disconnections
paraphrases: Bluetooth device will not stay paired
reference_text: Open Bluetooth settings. Select the paired accessory and tap Unpair. Scan and pair the accessory again. Charge the accessory before testing. Restart the phone if disconnections continue.

actions.description: It will rebuild the accessory pairing
It will rule out low power
It will reload Bluetooth system services
steps: Restart the phone if disconnections continue.

title: Device Overheating
canonical_query: device becomes hot during normal use
paraphrases: Galaxy heats up during normal use
The device shows a temperature warning
reference_text: Open Device care diagnostics. Review battery and application status. Close the application using the most resources. Disconnect the charger and remove the case. Move the device to a cool shaded place. Stop using the device if a temperature warning appears.

actions.description: It will identify resource intensive applications
steps: Close the application using the most resources.

actions.description: It will lower the device temperature
steps: Move the device to a cool shaded place.

actions.description: It will prevent heat related damage
steps: Stop using the device if a temperature warning appears.

title: Missing App Notifications
paraphrases: I only see messages after opening the app
reference_text: Open app notification settings. Select the affected application. Turn Allow notifications on. Review notification categories and enable the required category. Open Battery settings for the application and choose Optimized.

actions.description: It will restore allowed application alerts
It will permit timely background delivery
steps: Open Battery settings for the application.

title: Application Crashes
paraphrases: The app will not stay open
reference_text: Open application information. Tap Force stop and open the application again. Open Storage and tap Clear cache. Update the application from its trusted application store. Restart the phone if the crash continues.

actions.description: It will restart the affected application
It will install available stability fixes
steps: Update the application from its trusted application store.

actions.description: It will reload shared system services
steps: Restart the phone if the crash continues.

title: Touch Response Problems
paraphrases: Galaxy does not respond to swipes
Some areas do not react to touch
reference_text: Open Display settings. Turn Touch sensitivity on when using a screen protector. Remove the screen protector temporarily and test the screen. Wipe the screen with a clean dry cloth. Restart the phone if touch remains unresponsive.

actions.description: It will improve protected screen response
steps: Turn Touch sensitivity on when using a screen protector.

actions.description: It will remove physical touch interference
steps: Wipe the screen with a clean dry cloth.

actions.description: It will reload touchscreen system services
steps: Restart the phone if touch remains unresponsive.

title: Swipe Navigation Settings
canonical_query: swipe navigation moves in wrong direction after application install
paraphrases: Navigation gestures broke after an app install
My phone scrolls vertically instead of sideways
An installed app changed swipe behavior
reference_text: Navigate to and open Settings. Tap Display. Tap Navigation bar. Select your preferred navigation type between Buttons and Swipe gestures. Turn Gesture hint on to display guidance lines at the bottom of the screen.

actions.description: It will restore preferred navigation behavior
steps: Select your preferred navigation type between Buttons and Swipe gestures.
Turn Gesture hint on to display guidance lines at the bottom of the screen.
